step: Zola sits in an SSR cell, where Fennhoff becomes his new neighbor.
Years later, zombified heroes such as Hawkeye and Okoye still roam the ruined world.

entry.k: A Peruvian commander and old friend of Coulson
st: Reyes turns on Coulson's team and seizes their plane to take the 0-8-4 for Peru, until the agents retake it.

entry.k: A gravitonium expert kidnapped by Ian Quinn
st: Hall turns Quinn's gravitonium machine on the island, and Coulson shoots out the floor, dropping him into it.

entry.k: A former S.H.I.E.L.D. agent pulling impossible heists
st: Akela steals for unseen masters through an implanted eye, until Fitz and Simmons remove it and S.H.I.E.L.D. takes her in.

entry.k: A Centipede scientist working with Raina
st: Po runs Centipede's work and interrogates the captured Coulson, until the Clairvoyant has him killed.

entry.k: A gifted student at the S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy
st: Donnie tries to sell his weather machine to Ian Quinn, gains ice powers, and ends up locked away by S.H.I.E.L.D.
Brainwashed by HYDRA, Donnie turns his ice powers on S.H.I.E.L.D., and Skye shoots him dead.

entry.k: A Fridge escapee who drains energy
st: Daniels escapes the Fridge to find the cellist Audrey, and Coulson's team floods him with light until he dies.

entry.k: Powered outcasts Cal gathers for revenge
st: Cal gathers Karla Faye Gideon, Angar and others to strike at S.H.I.E.L.D., but Coulson, Bobbi and May subdue them.

entry.k: A young Inhuman girl in Bahrain
st: In a Bahrain flashback, young Katya controls the minds of everyone around her to kill, and May shoots her dead.

entry.k: A hulking Inhuman who hunts other Inhumans
st: In season 3, Lash hunts and kills new Inhumans, and is revealed as May's ex-husband, Andrew Garner.
Lash breaks Hive's hold on Daisy, and James kills him with a burning chain.

entry.k: Baron Strucker's son
st: In season 3, Werner joins Ward's HYDRA and tries to kidnap Andrew Garner, who turns into Lash and drives him off.

entry.k: Alien hunters who follow Sarge
st: In season 6, Jaco, Snowflake and Pax follow Sarge across worlds hunting Shrikes, and clash with S.H.I.E.L.D.

entry.k: A nightclub owner dealing in stolen goods
st: Raymond sells Howard Stark's stolen formula to Leet Brannis, and a Leviathan assassin kills him.

entry.k: A silent buyer of Howard Stark's stolen inventions
st: Brannis buys Stark's nitramene, and after Peggy captures him, Leviathan's Sasha Demidov kills him.

entry.k: A hitman tied to Calvin Chadwick
st: Hunt kills for Chadwick's cover-up, until Whitney Frost, angry at his mess, absorbs him into Zero Matter.

entry.k: A HYDRA spy inside Project Rebirth
st: Kruger attacks Project Rebirth to steal the serum, killing Erskine and wounding Steve before he can take it.

entry.k: Thanos's children, sent ahead to Earth
st: Ebony Maw and Cull Obsidian land on Earth, and zombies overwhelm them and turn them into the undead.

entry.k: A warlord gathering the Infinity Stones
st: Thanos comes to Earth with five Infinity Stones, and Ultron, now in Vision's body, slices him in half.

entry.k: Tony Stark's partner at Stark Industries
st: Killmonger exposes Stane as the man who paid for Tony's ambush, and Happy punches him as he tries to flee.

entry.k: An arms dealer with stolen vibranium
st: Killmonger kills Klaue and Rhodey during a vibranium deal and frames Wakanda for both deaths.

entry.k: The All-Father who banished his daughter Hela
st: Odin banishes a powerless Hela to Earth, then comes for the Ten Rings, and Hela and Wenwu defeat him.

entry.k: The mystery client known as the Rook
entry.op: The Red Guardian and Bucky Barnes
st: Unmasked as the Rook who sold out Howard Stark, Stane attacks Bucky and the Red Guardian, and Bucky kills him.

entry.k: The master of the Red Room
st: Dreykov orders the Winter Soldier to kill the Red Guardian, and Bucky returns to him claiming the job is done.

entry.k: A zealot who has taken over Knowhere
entry.op: Howard the Duck and Darcy Lewis
st: Having trapped the Collector, Kaecilius takes Howard and Darcy's egg to offer to Dormammu, until S.H.I.E.L.D. breaks in.

entry.k: The host of an intergalactic cruise
entry.op: Howard the Duck and Darcy Lewis
st: The Grandmaster invites Howard and Darcy aboard his cruise, planning to eat their newborn egg.
